overview: **41.1M** valid trips and **$1.18B** charged in 2024. Yellow taxis carry **98.4%** of them.
**October** is busiest (**3.81M** trips). July-August run about **20% lower** per day than Sep-Nov.
**88%** of pickups are in Manhattan, mostly short hops averaging **$16.24**.
JFK is the top pickup zone (**1.91M** trips) and earns **13.3%** of all revenue at **$63.86** a fare.
Average fare rose **10%** ($18.61 in Jan to **$20.51** in Dec). Card tips hold at about **22%**.
compare: Green: **657K** trips vs yellow's **40.4M**. Green's share fell from **1.9%** to **1.5%** over the year.
Yellow is **89%** Manhattan. Green is **59%** Manhattan, **25%** Queens and **14%** Brooklyn.
Green trips are shorter (**2.8 vs 3.4** mi) but slower, so revenue per mile is about equal (**$8.70 vs $8.54**).
Cash is twice as common in green (**26.6% vs 13.3%**), and card tips are lower (**19.5% vs 21.9%**).
zones: The top **10** of **263** zones produce **37%** of trips. **82.7%** of trips start and end in Manhattan.
**JFK (13.3%)** and **LaGuardia (7.4%)** earn over a fifth of all revenue from under **8%** of trips.
Queens to Manhattan is the largest cross-borough flow: **2.1M** trips (**5.2%**), mostly airport runs.
**Thursday** is busiest (**124K** trips a day). **Monday (96K)** and **Sunday (101K)** are quietest.
**Christmas -55%**, **July 4 -51%**, **Thanksgiving -39%** vs a typical same weekday. Columbus Day is business as usual (**+2%**).
demand: Demand peaks at **5-7 pm** on weekdays. The busiest hour of the week is **Thursday 6 pm (1.2% of trips)**.
No sharp morning peak: trips climb steadily from **7 am** to the **6 pm** high.
Average speed bottoms out at **9.7 mph** around 5 pm and roughly doubles to **20.8 mph** at 5 am.
**4-5 am** is the quietest hour, about **12x** fewer trips than 6 pm, and the fastest time to cross the city.
Saturday and Sunday nights (**midnight-3 am**) take a far bigger share than weekday nights.
quality: **41.83M** Bronze rows produced **41.08M** Silver rows (**98.2%** kept). Only **7** exact duplicates.
**97.8%** of the **752K** rejected rows are **negative amounts**: refunds and voids recorded as separate rows.
Rejection rate is **1.82%** for yellow vs **0.49%** for green, almost entirely refund rows.
Rejections rose from **1.28%** in January to **2.17%** in December. Worth watching in 2025 loads.
Gold trip totals **equal** Silver valid rows exactly, and the Gold notebook fails the run if they don't.
